learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will expand their word power by learning about Synonyms (same meaning), Antonyms (opposites), and Homophones (same sound).]
warm_up_hook: 🎩 Welcome to the Word Wizard Club! Did you know some words act like twins, some act like enemies, and some play tricks on our ears? Let's unlock the secrets of our vocabulary!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Synonyms are words that have the SAME or almost the same meaning. They are like word friends that can swap places in a sentence!
Antonyms are words that have OPPOSITE meanings. They are completely different from each other, like day and night!
Homophones are tricky words! They SOUND exactly the same when you speak them, but they have different spellings and completely different meanings.
examples_or_templates: Sun (the star in the sky) & Son (a boy child)
Sea (the ocean) & See (look with your eyes)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What is a synonym (same meaning) for the word 'Small'?
❓ Which word is an antonym (opposite) of 'Loud'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Match the Antonyms (opposites): 1. Up, 2. Happy, 3. Fast ---> A. Sad, B. Down, C. Slow
✍️ Choose the correct Homophone: 'The wind ____ away my hat.' (Blew / Blue)
subjective_practice.hint: One is a color, the other is an action done by the wind.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Replace the underlined word with a Synonym: 'The story was very <u>funny</u>.' (Hint: It starts with 'H' or 'C')

activity_or_assignment.title: 🃏 The Opposite Memory Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Make flashcards with 5 pairs of Antonyms (like Fast/Slow, Up/Down, Happy/Sad). Mix them face down on the table and take turns flipping two over. If they are opposites, you keep them!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Synonyms are words that mean the same thing (Big and Huge).
⭐ Antonyms are words with opposite meanings (Hot and Cold).
⭐ Homophones sound the same but are spelled differently and mean different things (See and Sea).
